control.title: Cross-border transfer assessment
control.description: Track where personal data is stored and accessed outside India, check against restricted country notifications and sectoral localisation rules.

implementation_notes: Owned by the Grievance Officer; process documented in the privacy runbook.

requirements.title: Respect restrictions on transfer outside India
requirements.guidance: Personal data may be transferred outside India except to countries the Central Government restricts by notification. Track destinations and monitor notifications. Sectoral rules (for example RBI) may impose stricter localisation.

requirements.title: Meet Central Government requirements for transfers abroad
requirements.guidance: When making personal data available outside India, meet any requirements the Central Government specifies by general or special order.
